explanation: The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created the heavens, the earth, and all life.
A group of people gathered to worship God and listen to his word.
A term referring to angels or heavenly beings who are close to God and serve him.
Persons with authority to judge and make decisions on behalf of God and the people.
The principle of acting in accordance with God's will and morality, including fair treatment of others.
The concept referring to the foundation upon which the world is built, both physically and spiritually.
To receive something, especially property or status, from a parent or ancestor after their death.
